zh.summary: 修复 Windows 窗口边缘无法拖动调整大小的问题，并改进插件更新后的生效提示。
highlights: 恢复窗口四边和四角的原生缩放操作，边缘区域随显示缩放比例调整，最大化和全屏时不占用内容区域。
通过命令行更换插件版本后，插件市场会提示已加载的服务端插件需要重启，避免把磁盘新版本误认为已生效。
内置官方 DeepSeek Harness 更新至 0.1.5-rc.2。
upgradeNotes: 插件更新提示检测版本号变化，不会自动中断运行中的任务；请保存任务后重启以加载新版本。

en.summary: Restore resizing from Windows window edges and improve activation notices after plugin updates.
highlights: Restore native resizing from all four edges and corners, with display-scaled borders that disappear when maximized or fullscreen.
After a command-line plugin version change, the market marks loaded server plugins as requiring a restart instead of implying that the disk version is already active.
Update the bundled official DeepSeek Harness core to 0.1.5-rc.2.
upgradeNotes: Plugin update detection tracks version changes and never interrupts running tasks automatically. Save your work and restart to activate updated host modules.
